examples.label: Table of contents entry linking to a page section
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-content-item" site="Global" id="toc-item-pricing" icon="hero-hashtag" icon_class="size-3.5 opacity-50">
  <.link href="#pricing" class="text-sm hover:underline">Pricing and billing</.link>
</.component>

examples.label: Current step in a checkout progress list
examples.source:
<.component
  component_name="chelekom-content-item"
  site="Global"
  id="content-item-checkout-payment"
  icon="hero-credit-card"
  icon_class="size-4"
  title="Step 2 of 3"
  title_class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide opacity-50"
  active
>
  Payment details
</.component>
